messages:
nina-sales: Quick heads-up: Aurora (healthcare) wants to trial their custom aurora-13b-eco on Dedicated EU with BYOK/HSM and 16k context. Need: tokenizer/kv compatibility check, ETA for onboarding, and rough 4-bit cost estimate. Artifact: https://aurora.models/13b-eco.tar.gz. CC @lucas-eng @anita-ml
lucas-eng: On it. First Q: tokenizer type and any custom normalization? Also confirm rotary and n_head.
nina-sales: Manifest shows tokenizer=bpe, n_head=32, rotary=true, ctx=16384. They said custom normalizer but didn't upload files yet. License allows transforms but we'll ask for explicit consent.
anita-ml: BPE is usually fine; custom normalizer can shift token offsets. Recommend we run an inspect to check vocab ordering & kv-layout. If normalizer differs we can add a small pre-tokenize adapter.
mark-sre: EU Dedicated + BYOK OK from infra, HSM onboarding needs certs and network plan. Need signed security questionnaire + DPA before we provision. SLA asks: p50 <=150ms for short prompts?
nina-sales: They requested p50 ~120ms and 99.9 uptime for POC.
lucas-eng: I'll run inspector now: command: `ri inspect --url https://aurora.models/13b-eco.tar.gz --tokenizer --kv`
ci-bot: Inspect job queued (id=121999). ETA ~1h.
lucas-eng: Inspect done: tokenizer vocab order mismatched (off-by-one tokens for some prefixes). KV-cache layout PASSED. Ops report: uses standard attention. Logs: https://redwood.internal/jobs/121999/logs
anita-ml: Token offset issue fix options: (1) customer supplies normalizer & vocab in canonical order, (2) we add adapter shim to normalize incoming text before tokenizing. Adapter validation ~1 business day.
mark-sre: Timeline: adapter + small eval (~500 prompts) + quant run = ~3 business days. HSM/legal adds variable time (5-10 bd). So optimistic ~10 bd for EU POC.
flora-secu: Security: need completed questionnaire and SOC2 report. For BYOK/HSM we require vendor certs and explicit contractual clause about key custody. I'll draft addendum for model transforms too.
nina-sales: I'll ask Aurora for normalizer files, quantized checkpoint (if any), and signed questionnaire. Also request explicit written consent to transform artifacts. Will update here. :rocket:
